items.title: CFTC Kicks Off Crypto Rulemaking, Bypassing a Stalled Congress
items.summary: The agency submitted a prerule on crypto asset transactions and markets to the White House for review, signaling it will build a derivatives framework on its own authority after the Clarity Act's collapse.

items.title: CFTC submits crypto market regulation plan for White House review
items.summary: The US commodities regulator submitted a new crypto market regulatory action for White House review days after the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act.

items.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000, Solana and Hyperliquid rally as crypto markets shrug off Clarity setback
items.summary: The moves comes as the SEC and CFTC advance crypto-related rulemaking despite the Clarity Act stalling in the Senate.

items.title: CFTC sends crypto rules to White House to review as Congress stalls on Clarity Act
items.summary: The regulator is moving ahead with crypto market rules as the SEC also opens a new path for tokenized stock trading.
